text: Digitalization requires museums to implicate new thought provoking and immersive ways to interact withits content. Holographic AI assistants which allow context based communication, might be the solutionfor enhancing visitor engagement. They enable dynamic dialogues between visitors and representations ofhistorical personalities, enriching educational experiences and making history more captivating and accessible.Scientific papers already show the use of cutting edge visualization via holograms [2, 3] with additionalgesture control and first attempts at implementing AI in museums by providing heritage chatbots [3]. Thisstudy will analyze the possibility of synergistically combing both holography and AI assistants to enableimmersive and historically accurate interactions between museum visitors and virtual personalities
